message.content: Comments in this codebase use lowercase with square-bracket annotations to enforce a machine-parsable, toolable format that eliminates case noise and enables automated extraction of metadata, dependencies, and documentation. The square-bracket syntax—e.g., `[type: input] [owner: alice] [deprecated: true]`—provides a deterministic key-value structure that linters, code generators, and static analyzers can reliably parse without regex gymnastics, while the all-lowercase constraint ensures consistent rendering in generated docs and prevents accidental case-mismatch errors in automated tooling.
